spec.requirement: A user can attach rabbit-hole to ANY AI agent process — closed-source binaries included, zero SDK — and collect kernel-level telemetry of that agent's actions. Attach works in a degraded `--no-ebpf` mode on hosts without eBPF privileges, and the degraded mode is honest: no scary eBPF warnings after the user has opted out (dogfood friction F1, foreman row DF-RABBIT-HOLE-2).
spec.acceptance: Attaching to a live process in `--no-ebpf` mode produces a session that transitions to `completed` (never a false `crashed`) within one poll interval of process exit; a long-lived session stays `running` with no false crash.
spec.verification: Go tests: internal/attach/monitor_test.go (session lifecycle monitor), internal/attach/e2e_test.go (real-TCP serve/attach/detach walk). Machine-checked citation deferred until the auger go-runner lands (RH-TOOLING-001).
spec.requirement: Classification runs against three interchangeable backends with one contract: pattern-only (zero-config default, /health truthfully reports "degraded — pattern-only"), a local LLM (gemma via ollama), and a remote gRPC classifier (serve --remote, token-authenticated, contract in api/proto/classifier/v1).
spec.acceptance: /health names the ACTIVE backend and its mode truthfully for all three configurations; the remote gRPC path serves Classify/Ping/Info under token auth.
spec.verification: Go tests: internal/classify/remote_test.go, internal/classify/server_integration_test.go, cmd/rabbit-hole/health_version_test.go. Machine-checked citation deferred (RH-TOOLING-001).
spec.requirement: Sessions, flows and traces persist in SQLite with migration idempotency: applying migration001 twice is a no-op, and concurrent daemon starts do not fail on "table already exists" (foreman row DF-009, commit 0ccd188).
spec.acceptance: `go test ./internal/storage/...` proves double-apply idempotency and that time-range queries/compaction are timezone-agnostic (unixepoch comparison, foreman row DF-034).
spec.verification: Go tests: internal/storage/sqlite_test.go (TestMigrate_ApplyTwiceIsNoOp, TestQueryFlows_TimezoneAgnosticTimeRange, TestCompact_TimezoneAgnosticCutoff), internal/storage/storage_test.go. Machine-checked citation deferred (RH-TOOLING-001).
